stem: Simon's paper needs a position statement. Which of these sentences could best follow sentence 7 and state the position that Simon is taking in this paper?

options.label: F
options.text: It's time to require cyclists to register and license their bikes.

options.label: G
options.text: If they're going to use public roadways, they should own them, too.

options.label: H
options.text: They're drivers and should be given the respect that they deserve.

options.label: J
options.text: We have many bicyclists on the roadways of our town.
